catalog.name: Swap
catalog.about: Trade one Solana token for another from your wallet. Salmon asks its backend for the best route, shows you exactly what leaves and what arrives, and signs only on your confirmation. Nothing is sent until you approve it.

actions.quote: Get a live quote between any two tokens in the catalogue
actions.review: Review the rate, the fees and the minimum you receive before signing
actions.receipt: Keep a receipt with the on-chain signature once it lands

catalog.uses: Your address and token balances go to the Salmon API to build the route. No third party sees your keys.

fee_disclaimer: Salmon's fee is shown as its own line before you confirm.

review.title: Swap Review
review.pleaseNoteText: Swap rates are estimates. The actual amount you receive may differ due to slippage and market conditions. Transactions are irreversible once confirmed.

unavailable.network: Swap is available on Solana mainnet only.
unavailable.region: Swap is not available in your region.
unavailable.wallet: Swap is not available for this wallet.

errors.highPriceImpact: High price impact! You may receive significantly less than expected.
errors.unknownToken: One of these tokens is not supported for swapping.
